Round 357 (PERF-10a) stopped: B needs to make a ruling. The code-reviewer found a Medium issue that no existing ruling covers, and I can't fix it without changing the form B ruled. I left the tree as it was: B's two patches applied exactly, plus doc 234. I changed no code after the review, made no commits, and marked no backlog item complete.

**The issue.** On `/studio-lab`, resizing from wide to narrow and back remounts `StudioWorkspace` while the provider keeps running. The new playback leaf is a child component, so its effect now runs before the tempo-seed effect instead of after it, and it writes the status with an updater function instead of a plain string. Two things can differ from HEAD:
- **Status text:** if the status at that moment is an insert-marker status or "Follow paused", HEAD drops the tempo text that the remount re-adds; my tree keeps it.
- **Screen-reader announcement:** if the status already equals the stopped text, HEAD announces it again and my tree doesn't.

Sketch-review finding 4 only covered a mount while playing, so it doesn't apply here. B can either accept this as an intended difference and add a wide → narrow → wide test, or require HEAD's behaviour, which changes the ruled form.

**How far I confirmed it.**
- The demo "Night Pulse · Full mix" and its stems carry a BPM, and a browser probe on :5173 showed the tempo text being added again on remount.
- My ruler click did not produce an insert-marker status, so I never reached the state where HEAD and my tree differ. I did not run HEAD in a browser, so the difference itself is not reproduced there.
- Separately, the probe showed the tempo text appearing twice after a remount. Reading the code, HEAD should do the same, so this isn't from this round, but I didn't check it on HEAD. I proposed it as a Low (`A-R357-TEMPO-SEED-REMOUNT-DUP`) for B to confirm.

**Rows I ran:**

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| A-CLAIMS pre | Identical to the planning output. |
| A-CLAIMS final | Matches the sketch output except the two lines the task expects to change: K2 = `d49536b 56 … 0`, K13 `doc234:1`. |
| A-TYPE | `npm run typecheck` rc 0. |
| A-LINT | `npm run lint` rc 0, 205 warnings (exactly the cap). |
| A-COVER | 69 files, 1273/1273 passed. The slowest test took 7.0 s against a 30 s timeout. |
| A-MUTANT | M-B1 to M-B4 fail exactly the same tests as B's logs. `store/` was unchanged and the scratch copy was deleted. |
| A-PERF | Run alone on a production build: rc 0, all 84 asserted rows pass, no new rows, `durationMs` 480142. Only the four `interact.play.*-components` rows changed, 70 → 28 at 1× and 6×. Every other compared row equals C356. |
| A-DOC | Doc 234 is written with line 4 exactly as required and the 7 template headings in order. If B requires HEAD's behaviour, it needs updating. |
| A-REVIEW | **Not passed** (the Medium above). |

**For B:**
- **Reviewer Lows.** The reviewer flagged three Lows: a status bug that can't happen today but could if a future caller stops playback outside a React event, a flakiness risk in FW-PB1 (a real 50 ms wait with act turned off), and two different ways of reading `isPlaying`. B already accepted the last one in sketch-review finding 7. All three are listed by ID in the report.
- **Architecture note (a proposal, not acted on).** The reviewer says keep the store. It also suggests a Georgian architecture note on the split playback hooks and the read policy, plus a remount regression test.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-357.md`, with evidence under `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-357/`.
